title: Questionnaire NARCIS Notification app
descriptions: This dataset contains the raw data and data comparisons based on the results of a questionnaire held in 2013. The total amount of 322 respondents consists of both student and scientists. The questionnaire was made up of fourteen questions about the background of the respondents (age, field of study, academic position, etc.), the way they collect scientific material, and how the respondents would evaluate the NARCIS Notification application and its functions.
